invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List<WriteStatus> that should not be null after the postWrite step.
The input records are expected to be non-null; method logic does not handle null preppedRecords.
instantTime is used in multiple method calls and passed to downstream components, implying it should be non-null.
If result is empty, it is likely that the input preppedRecords was empty, as no write operations would have been performed.
